title: Parts sourcing report
description: Supply Agent domain output: availability and shipment status of an approved part. Approval is DISCREPANCY-SPECIFIC: part_approved refers to the workflow's discrepancy, per the approved-parts registry's applicable_discrepancies. Supply cannot approve substitutions or purchases (AGT-2); shipment_status and eta_days are reported from the synthetic supply-chain data, never invented. Traceability: AGT-2. All data synthetic (SUB-5). (v3: description/semantics reconciled to the discrepancy-specific rule; payload shape unchanged from v2.)

part_approved.description: True iff part_number is approved FOR THIS WORKFLOW'S DISCREPANCY (applicable_discrepancies in the approved-parts registry) — global registry membership is not sufficient.

eta_days.description: Logical days until arrival from report time.
